name: kimi_k3_decode_workload_model_v1
causal_hypothesis: A sourced per-token operation and byte model will identify whether expert weights, KDA state, MLA cache traffic, or arithmetic should set the first microarchitecture budget.
stock_control: Generic accelerator roofline with all persistent state in external memory.
candidates: KDA state served from high-bandwidth local memory
Expert-weight reuse across a token batch
Resource-matched KDA and tiled matrix engines
quality_gate: Every model input has a source and evidence label. Layer counts are internally consistent. Larger context cannot reduce MLA work. Larger batch cannot increase common weight bytes per token.
slo: Produce deterministic JSON, CSV, and HTML artifacts in less than 30 minutes with no external spend.
cleanup: No external compute or persistent service is created.
transfer_limits: The roofline is an ideal analytical lower bound, not a GPU or ASIC measurement.
The operation model does not yet include every elementwise, normalisation, collective, scheduling, or package cost.
Random independent expert routing is an explicit reuse assumption, not a measured Kimi K3 trace.
No B300, Vera Rubin, area, power, cost, or full-chip performance claim is supported.
